name: ChannelSale: WooCommerce Plugin to Sync Multi-Marketplace Product Listings, Orders
author: ChannelSale

sections.description:
ChannelSale WooCommerce plugin connects Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Google Shopping, Wayfair, Etsy, Newegg, BestBuy, Bed Bath & Beyond, Houzz, Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, TikTok, Fruugo, OnBuy and many more thru a single interface.
Automatically Sync Product Catalog, Inventory, Orders and Shipping Tracking updates across multi-marketplaces, avoiding over-selling or under-selling issues!

Start Risk-Free with a FREE PLAN for Inventory and Orders Sync

Experience the efficiency of ChannelSale before making any commitment. See firsthand how ChannelSale simplifies marketplace operations, improves synchronization, and helps accelerate growth.

Our team marketplace specialists will help complete setup, provide online screen-sharing demo handovers, and optionally we can schedule weekly recurring meetings for actioning best-practice strategies for simplified, fast-paced sales growth.

Automate Marketplace Operations

  • Synchronize inventory across marketplaces in near real time.
  • Automatically process orders and update shipment tracking.
  • Reduce manual tasks and prevent overselling.

Accelerate Sales Growth

  • Professional product listing creation and optimization.
  • Industry best practices for better search visibility.
  • Improved conversion rates and marketplace performance.

Every plan includes FREE fully managed setup and onboarding by our expert team, ensuring a fast, seamless implementation so you can start selling with confidence.

Managing multiple marketplaces can be complex—different listing requirements, inventory updates, pricing changes, orders, and shipping workflows can quickly become time-consuming and difficult to manage. ChannelSale eliminates these challenges by connecting your sales channels into one streamlined platform.

Integrations

Amazon ★ eBay ★ Walmart ★ Google Shopping ★ Facebook ★ Instagram ★ TikTok ★ Etsy ★ Wayfair ★ Bed Bath & Beyond ★ BestBuy ★ Newegg ★ Temu ★ Wish.com ★ Sears ★ Mercado Libre ★ Fruugo ★ Shopping.com ★ Pricegrabber ★ many more

Main Features

  • Enables integration via WooCommerce API, ChannelSale plugin retrieves your product listings catalog and synchronizes across the major online marketplaces.
  • Near real-time sync for inventory, orders, shipping tracking updates across multi-marketplaces, to avoid over-selling and under-selling.
  • Supports simple or multi-variation products with multiple attributes.
  • Variable pricing for each marketplace, markup pricing over cost price, and automated repricer support.
  • Custom product data attributes to optimize listings on shopping sites.
  • Business rules to modify product data, suppress products, and add new content.
  • Supports pre-configured integrations with shipping, inventory, order fulfilment software, and accounting software.

Benefits of ChannelSale WooCommerce Plugin

  • Single plugin supports all integrations with Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Google Shopping, Wayfair, Etsy, Newegg, Bed Bath & Beyond, Houzz, Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, and many more.
  • Manage listings and orders across all supported marketplaces.
  • Extensively tried and tested platform with millions of products listed and synchronized across multi-channels.
  • Supports multi-warehouse and multi-currency.
  • In-depth training for operational staff via online demos, telephone meets, and emails.
  • Professional advice and strategies for performance review and optimizations.
  • Access to joint webinars with industry top-level experts.
  • Compatibility with most major cross-network services and solution providers.
  • Ongoing product development and inclusion of new features as they are introduced.
  • Full ownership of all data within the platform.
  • No setup fees for any ChannelSale pre-configured integrations.
  • No long-term contracts, pay as you go on a monthly basis.
  • No commission on sales.

ChannelSale WooCommerce Plugin is tried and tested with proven results for many online sellers. It comes with an expert support team, highly experienced and responsive to assist in your goals for rapid sales growth and to simplify product listings and orders management.

ChannelSale Story Briefly

  • Launched in 2007, offering a world-class software platform for simplified multi-channel selling.
  • Preferred Integration official partner with most major marketplaces, comparison shopping engines, affiliate networks, and social shopping sites.

What Makes ChannelSale Different?

  • Developed and maintained by veteran engineers focused on the online selling industry for decades.
  • Platform offers ease of product listings across multiple sales channels, detailed analytic capabilities, and expert assistance to manage your multi-marketplace sales program.
  • Assisted Deployment Program to delegate the actual work of distributing and optimizing your product offers across channels.
  • No sales commissions on transactions done, flat fee structure.
  • Continual product development and process improvements to stay future-ready and scalable.

Account setup & Pricing

  • Free Plan available for Inventory and Order Sync. Supports up to 15 orders per month.

For other plans pricing information, click here.

  • To activate WooCommerce plugin a ChannelSale account is required to be created, please contact us via email info@channelsale.com to proceed. After verifying that your requirements are met, our team will send you an email with the link to create the new account, we are happy to help!

  • Plugin readily available to download and install. If you have any questions, our experienced support team members from ChannelSale are available to assist you to complete the setup efficiently.

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 4.7 or greater
  • WooCommerce 2.6.0 or greater
  • PHP version 5.2 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.0 or greater

Support

If you need support or have any questions, kindly contact us on Toll-free phone +1-866-709-9495 | Email: info@channelsale.com | Website: www.channelsale.com

sections.installation:
Please contact ChannelSale via email support@channelsale.com for our team to provide complete managed setup support at no cost for the free plan. After checking that your requirements can be met with the plugin features, our team will send you an email with the link to create a new account and get started, we are happy to help!

Install the plugin through the WordPress plugins page directly by clicking ‘Add New’ and selecting the zip file from your computer.

Or

Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/ directory

Activate the ChannelSale WordPress plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

Website: www.channelsale.com
sections.faq:
Does the plugin support creating product listings on marketplaces like Amazon, eBay and others?

Yes, plugin creates new product listings, updates existing listings on the marketplaces. Also supports variation listings.

Does it support sync Orders and Shipping updates from multi-marketplaces to WooCommerce?

Yes, the plugin enables importing orders from multi-marketplaces into WooCommerce, and then sends back the shipping tracking updates from WooCommerce to the multi-marketplaces

Which marketplaces integrations are available?

Amazon ★ eBay ★ Walmart ★ Google Shopping ★ Facebook ★ Instagram ★ TikTok ★ Etsy ★ Wayfair ★ Bed Bath & Beyond ★ BestBuy ★ Newegg ★ Wish.com ★ Sears ★ Temu ★ Mercado Libre ★ Shopping.com ★ Pricegrabber ★ Fruugo ★ OnBuy many more

Is there a demo?

We can schedule a live demo meet, please email us your requirements on info@channelsale.com

What does the Free Plan include?

Free Plan available for Inventory and Order Sync. Includes sync inventory for up to 500 products on marketplaces and up to 15 orders per month.

What does the Free Trial plan include?

Free Trial includes the above features of Free Plan and includes creating sample product listings on any 1 marketplace Amazon, eBay or Walmart.

Pricing plans

View our pricing plans and contact us here.

What are the steps to install and activate plugin and where can I get support?

To activate WooCommerce plugin a ChannelSale account is required to be created, please contact us via email info@channelsale.com to proceed, or contact us here. After verifying that your requirements are met, our team will send you an email with the link to create the new account, we are happy to help!

Other queries

Please contact us via email info@channelsale.com, or here.
